title: Private, Social, or Eco?
why: Warm leads stuck choosing. Lays out all three products without blurring them (private fleet, social per-seat, eco tour), with real prices and a real review as proof.
hook_options: Private, shared, or eco? Pick the right one.
Same dock, three very different boat trips
Just two of you? You don't need the whole boat.
caption: Same dock, three different trips. Private party fleet for your own group, social seats if it's just a couple of you, or the slower eco tour for wildlife and kids. Gators common on all three, guaranteed on none. Save this before you book. #neworleans #nola #swamptour #bachelorette #partyboat

slides.headline: Private, shared, or eco? Pick right.
Three different trips. Don't mix them up.
slides.body: All leave 2101 Paris Road, 7 miles from the Quarter. What happens on board is very different.

slides.headline: Your group only. Up to 25.
slides.body: Freaky Tiki or Twerkin' Tiki for 25, Party Queen for 22, Bayou Boogie for 18. BYOB, your playlist, no strangers.

slides.headline: $1,200 for the whole boat
slides.body: 1 hour 45 on the water. Split across 25 guests, that's $48 a head. Price as of Oct 1, 2026.

slides.headline: Just two of you? Grab a seat.
slides.body: Per-seat tickets on a shared party boat. Mixed groups, good energy, 21 and up. $59 a seat.

slides.headline: Slower boat. Quieter. Kids welcome.
slides.body: About 2 hours. Captains talk wildlife and coastal land loss. Restrooms on board, heated in winter. From $50.

slides.headline: Gators: common, not guaranteed
slides.body: They're seasonal and weather dependent. Anyone who promises you a gator is guessing.

slides.headline: 'Nervous with the rain.' Then this.
slides.body: 'The boat was fully covered and we stayed dry and dancing the whole time.' Sara C.

slides.headline: Group of 15+? Private. Two of you? Seats.
slides.body: Kids, or a quiet trip with the birds? Eco tour. Still stuck? Message us your group size.

slides.headline: Pick your trip. Bring your people.
slides.body: 4.9 on Google. 3,800+ reviews across platforms. nolapartybarges.com
